turns.en: I'd like to send you for a blood test, just to rule a couple of things out. The nurse will do it today, and we should have results by Friday.
turns.cy: Mi faswn i'n licio'ch anfon chi am brawf gwaed, jyst i ddiystyru cwpwl o betha. Mi wneith y nyrs o heddiw, ac mi ddylen ni gael canlyniadau erbyn dydd Gwener.
chunks: I'd like to send you for a blood test
Mi faswn i'n licio'ch anfon chi am brawf gwaed
just to rule a couple of things out
jyst i ddiystyru cwpwl o betha
English's split particle 'rule out' has nothing to split in Welsh — diystyru carries it
The nurse will do it today
Mi wneith y nyrs o heddiw
and we should have results by Friday
ac mi ddylen ni gael canlyniadau erbyn dydd Gwener

turns.en: Fine by me. Whatever you think best.
turns.cy: Mae hynny'n iawn gen i. Beth bynnag dach chi'n feddwl sy ora.
chunks: English's verbless fragment needs a Welsh clause; 'by me' becomes the conjugated gen i
Beth bynnag dach chi'n feddwl sy ora
the bynnag free-relative, with a sy' relative under it that English can leave out

turns.en: Good. It's a simple one - no fasting needed, and it takes two minutes.
turns.cy: Da iawn. Un syml ydy o — dim angen ymprydio, ac mae o'n cymryd dau funud.
chunks: identificatory fronting; the indefinite article erases
the bare negative angen frame (R3), as at 'no need to apologise'
ac mae o'n cymryd dau funud

turns.en: Look and know rather than guess. I like that.
turns.cy: Edrych a gwybod yn hytrach na dyfalu. Dw i'n licio hynna.
chunks: Look and know rather than guess
Edrych a gwybod yn hytrach na dyfalu

turns.en: Exactly right. Keep taking the tablets in the meantime - don't wait for the results.
turns.cy: Yn union. Daliwch i gymryd y tabledi yn y cyfamser — peidiwch ag aros am y canlyniadau.
chunks: English's 'right' erases — yn union alone is the Welsh ratifier
Keep taking the tablets in the meantime
Daliwch i gymryd y tabledi yn y cyfamser
peidiwch ag aros am y canlyniadau
peidiwch ag before a vowel; aros governs am

turns.en: Righto. Tablets regardless. Thank you, doctor.
turns.cy: Reit-o. Tabledi beth bynnag. Diolch, doctor.

turns.en: I'd like to send you for a blood test, just to rule a couple of things out.
turns.cy: Mi faswn i'n licio'ch anfon chi am brawf gwaed, jyst i ddiystyru cwpwl o betha.
chunks: I'd like to send you for a blood test
Mi faswn i'n licio'ch anfon chi am brawf gwaed
just to rule a couple of things out
jyst i ddiystyru cwpwl o betha

turns.en: What are you testing for, exactly? Should I be worried?
turns.cy: Am be'n union dach chi'n profi? Ddylwn i boeni?
chunks: What are you testing for, exactly?
Am be'n union dach chi'n profi?
Welsh fronts the preposition with the interrogative — English strands it
Welsh has no be-worried passive here — the verb poeni carries it

turns.en: Infection and anaemia, mainly. The tiredness could just be the infection, but I'd rather look and know than guess.
turns.cy: Haint ac anemia, gan fwya. Mi allai'r blinder fod yn haint yn unig, ond mae'n well gen i edrych a gwybod na dyfalu.
chunks: The tiredness could just be the infection
Mi allai'r blinder fod yn haint yn unig
'just' here is restrictive and lands clause-finally as yn unig, not as jyst and not erased
but I'd rather look and know than guess
ond mae'n well gen i edrych a gwybod na dyfalu
preference relocates to mae'n well gen i — the N-form fork
south: mae'n well gyda fi — AND A REORDER
turns.southLine: Haint ac anemia, gan fwyaf. Fe allai'r blinder fod yn haint yn unig, ond mae'n well gyda fi edrych a gwybod na dyfalu.

turns.en: That's fair enough. Do I do it now?
turns.cy: Mae hynny'n ddigon teg. Ydw i'n ei neud o rŵan?
chunks: Welsh puts digon before the adjective, where English puts 'enough' after
Ydw i'n ei neud o rŵan?

turns.en: The nurse can do it today - and we'll text you if it's normal, or ring you if anything needs a chat.
turns.cy: Mi fedar y nyrs ei neud o heddiw — ac mi wnawn ni decstio os ydy o'n normal, neu ffonio os oes 'na rywbeth angen sgwrs.
chunks: The nurse can do it today
Mi fedar y nyrs ei neud o heddiw
and we'll text you if it's normal
ac mi wnawn ni decstio os ydy o'n normal
English's object 'you' erases — tecstio is intransitive in this register
or ring you if anything needs a chat
neu ffonio os oes 'na rywbeth angen sgwrs

turns.en: A text if it's normal, a call if it's not. Understood.
turns.cy: Tecst os ydy o'n normal, galwad os nad ydy o. Dallt.
chunks: A text if it's normal, a call if it's not
Tecst os ydy o'n normal, galwad os nad ydy o
English's gapped 'if it's not' cannot gap in Welsh — the verb must return

turns.en: I'd like the nurse to take some blood today, and we'll have results by Friday.
turns.cy: Mi faswn i'n licio i'r nyrs gymryd gwaed heddiw, ac mi gawn ni ganlyniadau erbyn dydd Gwener.
chunks: I'd like the nurse to take some blood today
Mi faswn i'n licio i'r nyrs gymryd gwaed heddiw
English's ECM relocates to licio i + subject + verbal noun; 'some' erases
and we'll have results by Friday
ac mi gawn ni ganlyniadau erbyn dydd Gwener

turns.en: I can't do today - I'm picking the grandchildren up at three. Can I come back tomorrow?
turns.cy: Fedra i ddim heddiw — dw i'n nôl y wyrion am dri. Ga i ddod yn ôl fory?
chunks: English's pro-verb 'do' erases — Welsh has none to render
I'm picking the grandchildren up at three
dw i'n nôl y wyrion am dri
English's split particle 'pick up' has nothing to split; nôl carries it
Ga i ddod yn ôl fory?

turns.en: Tomorrow's fine - book at the desk on your way out. Mornings are quietest.
turns.cy: Mae fory'n iawn — archebwch wrth y ddesg ar eich ffordd allan. Y boreau sy dawela.
chunks: book at the desk on your way out
archebwch wrth y ddesg ar eich ffordd allan
the sy'-focus superlative — Welsh identifies which are quietest rather than merely predicating it

turns.en: Do I need an appointment, or just turn up?
turns.cy: Ydw i angen apwyntiad, 'ta jyst troi i fyny?
chunks: the alternative-question 'ta (§4); 'just' outside an imperative keeps jyst

turns.en: Book at the desk to be safe. And keep taking the tablets in the meantime - don't wait for results.
turns.cy: Archebwch wrth y ddesg i fod yn saff. A daliwch i gymryd y tabledi yn y cyfamser — peidiwch ag aros am ganlyniadau.
chunks: Book at the desk to be safe
Archebwch wrth y ddesg i fod yn saff
And keep taking the tablets in the meantime
A daliwch i gymryd y tabledi yn y cyfamser
distinct from 'don't wait for THE results' → …am y canlyniadau

turns.en: Text good, call thorough, tablets regardless. You've a way of making it simple.
turns.cy: Tecst yn dda, galwad yn drylwyr, tabledi beth bynnag. Mae gynnoch chi ffordd o'i neud o'n syml.
chunks: Text good, call thorough, tablets regardless
Tecst yn dda, galwad yn drylwyr, tabledi beth bynnag
English's telegraphic apposition needs the Welsh predicative yn on each adjective
You've a way of making it simple
Mae gynnoch chi ffordd o'i neud o'n syml
possession relocates to the existential with conjugated gan
south: mae … gyda chi — AND A REORDER
turns.southLine: Tecst yn dda, galwad yn drylwyr, tabledi beth bynnag. Mae ffordd gyda chi o'i wneud e'n syml.
